Plus they're cute! I will say from (many) experience (s) that they don't fit well on adult heads, so just a heads up for those whose toddlers like mommy and daddy to dress up with them (baby brother fits well though 👍). These crowns are perfect and light weight for little princess heads! My kids are very excited to play with them!

When we received this package, right away we noticed that 2 tiaras & 2 wands were missing from the pack, but on top of that, the quality of this product is just... terrible!! I've received quite a few poor quality items from Amazon over the years, but this may be the worst by far which is why I am leaving this review so other people don't waste their money. My child played with one of the wands for less than a day and it completely fell apart and is ready to be thrown away. These should maaaybe

Tiaras are pretty important right now.  We've had good luck with these.  Inexpensive but does the job.

These are really gorgeous in person. I shopped around trying to find the best quality without spending a ton, and I am very happy that I chose these. We had them for my daughter's birthday party and they have survived the past 3 months of heavy use with multiple girls (we have a lot of play dates) and we have only had one that the jewel came out of- it was a quick super glue fix, and was good as new. These are definitely a good addition to any dress up/costume/birthday/ whatever!

The colors I revieved do not match the description or pictures - there is no 'Elsa' light blue (it is a dark blue) nor 'Anna' pink (it is a pale pink). I recieved pale pink, dark blue, red, light green, gold and white/clear. These crowns are also very small - they are too small for my 3 year old and look as if they would fit an infant. Not worth returning and would not reccomend.

I bought these for my 1 year old daughter. She simply loves wearing them on her head 24/7!! She picks one out in the morning and wears it the whole day without taking it off! However we have only had them for a week and one is snapped in half and the another is seemingly about to be. They are not good quality but they get the job done i supposed since they make my daughter happy

My daughter was super excited to receive this. She waited by the mailbox. When we opened it - two of the colored tiaras were cracked... Unfortunately I have to keep the defective items because I didn't want to break my little one's heart and tell her we needed to send them back. They will be broken within days because of the location of the cracks. DISAPPOINTED.

Bought these to use on a pull apart cake. Wands are all different shapes and do not match what is pictured. They are all painted a dark pink and green color. There are no gems on them at all. I requested a replacement of the correct ones and still received the same product. Very dissatisfied with this product.

I requested a replacement of the correct ones and still received the same product. Very dissatisfied with this product.

Cheap and easily broken. This is the second set we’ve bought. The first set came with 3/6 of the items broken, I got a replacement and now all 3 crowns have broken in less than a month. The jewels fall out easily as well. We’ve had the set from Melissa and Doug for the past 2 years and they are still intact.

We are missing the purple tiara. We received one blue and two pink tiaras instead. The scepters do not match tiaras. They are all dark pink and green. The scepters do not even have gems on them. The spaces for the gems are just painted. One of the scepters is also bent and has a piece of it cracked off.

This is exactly the same one we got from the princess costumes. The one coming with the costume is broken, that's why I bought them from here. And they are just like the pictures, serving the purpose, no big defects or anything, not sure why the review is not good. I like them. Recommend.

reviews.t: THEY ARE WORTH EXACTLY WHAT EACH ONE COST! DON’T WASTE YOUR MONEY!!
reviews.x: Several snapped while trying them on.  She’s got 3 left that aren’t broke and they can’t be superglued once broke apart.  Spend this money and get one of the better quality ones.  I wish I had!!  If I hadn’t got mad and threw several in the trash I would have asked for a refund.

Very cute, love the different colors, it comes in pieces which I think is great when wanting to pack it back it back up for whatever reason then use again whenever. Only issue is that the materials are weak and can break easy, also some gems are glued wrong

I bought these for my 3 year old daughter and they did not last long at all. The jewels were popped out in the package and the wands were mostly bent. Super cheap plastic. Definitely could have gotten a better product elsewhere. 10/10 Do not recommend.

These are awful. The very first use expect to find the gems falling off and the paint completely work off the handle and stained on your child’s hand. They are NOT worth the price by any means. I would maybe spend a dollar. Horrible, horrible quality.

reviews.t: My girls love them but they fell apart
reviews.x: The crowns and wands are adorable but within 2 minutes of opening them pieces fell off two of the wands.  Since my girls are having fun playing with them I just super glued the pieces back on but disappointed that they fell off in the first place.

reviews.t: Good Quality, Pretty and Sized Just Right for a 4 Year Old : )
reviews.x: Our preschooler LOVED her set of new tiaras. They snapped together easily, arrived undamaged and fit her really well. We would recommend the set of 6 multi-color if you have a little one that likes to play princess every day.

Cheaply done. We had to super glue stones back into the crowns the day we received them, apparently they fell out while enroute. Probably should have gotten them at the Dollar Store would have been cheaper but same quality.

Sadly I was planning to make this a Christmas gift for a 9 year old girl.  One of the stones on one of the tiaras there was a clump of glue.  One of the stones on one of the tiaras came off when the packing was opened.  SAD

claims.text: Many reviewers find the crowns cute and well-suited for young children, noting they fit toddler heads and stay on well.
Several reviewers report durability problems, with crowns cracking, snapping, or breaking and jewels falling off.
Some reviewers complain about missing pieces, cracked items on arrival, or products not matching the description and pictures.
A few reviewers raise safety concerns about the headband's teeth potentially damaging skin.
Some reviewers note the crowns are too small for older children or adults.
